title: Barrage: Shmup and Bullet Hell Sound Effects
shortText: 138 shmup SFX: six guns at three power tiers, power levels, chain, graze, boss phases, each a ladder. WAV + OGG.
html:
A shoot em up escalates. These sounds escalate with it.

138 shmup and bullet hell sound effects: six guns at three power tiers, power levels, a chain counter, a graze combo, explosions by size and boss phases, each built as a ladder that climbs, plus the rest of a run.

Licence, up front

Royalty free. Commercial use. No attribution required. Use it in as many games as you like, on any platform. The one thing you may not do is resell or redistribute the sounds themselves as a sound pack. The plain language terms ship as LICENSE.txt, with a copy and paste credit line for anyone who wants one. Everything is synthesised from code, so there is no upstream sample licence behind it.

Hear it first

There is a free demo on this page: 21 sounds copied unaltered from the paid files. The laser at all three tiers (both takes), all 5 power levels, the 6 step chain, the death and respawn pair, the boss WARNING siren and a bomb.

The ladder is the product

A shmup needs more than one laser and one explosion. Here the vulcan, laser, spread, homing, wave and needle guns each ship at three power tiers, two takes per tier, so tier 3 is the gun you started with grown up and autofire does not repeat one file. Then five power levels, a six step chain, a four step graze combo, the charge release at three levels, explosions in three sizes and three boss phase transitions. That is 12 ladders, and every one was measured from the shipped files: 30 steps, each at least 8% brighter or 12% longer than the one below, every ladder at least 1.5x end to end. Failing steps: 0.

What is in it

  • Player shots (36)
  • Charge and beam (7)
  • Power ups (10)
  • Graze (8)
  • Bomb and screen clear (8)
  • Enemy fire (11)
  • Hits and explosions (14)
  • Score and chain (13)
  • Player state (8)
  • Boss (12)
  • Stage and menu (11)

Fit

  • WAV and OGG for every file, 16 bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, with a naming manifest listing every file by group.
  • 4 seamless loops (the boss WARNING siren, the charge, the beam and the ship's engine) with loop points written into the WAV and the OGG.
  • 34 variation sets whose takes differ in length and in brightness.
  • One loudness band: the inner 80 percent of the pack sits inside 0.85 dB, so a needle shot and a boss blast share a mix.
  • Import notes for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker and the web, and pack_proof.json with a sha256 and a measurement for every file: 1255 checks, 0 failed.

One board

Every file is played on one small imaginary arcade board: two FM voices, one noise channel and one low thump, through one output stage. No chip voice, no bit crushing, no samples. Each gun keeps one voice at every tier, so a power up reads as the same weapon getting stronger.

Honest limits

These are synthesised sounds. The figures above are signal measurements, not a claim that anything sounds good; that is what the free demo is for. No music, no voices and no ambience beds.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the code that generates these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds themselves are self contained procedural synthesis by Core Systems Asset Factory, with no generative audio model at any point. The cover art and store graphics are AI generated.

The other Barrage listings

Same studio, same genre, different products. Barrage for GameMaker is a bullet pattern system and Barrage for RPG Maker MZ turns enemy attacks into dodge battles. This page is the sound pack: plain audio files that work with either of them, or with neither.

More from the same studio

  • Ship Systems, sci fi interface and machinery: the cockpit, the consoles and the hangar around the fight.
  • Descent, the roguelike run and its meta loop: runs, pickups, upgrades and the shop between them.
  • Tally, clicker and idle feedback built as ladders too: counts, combos and milestones that climb.
